integrity: The whole-trajectory result is proved analytically using the exact scalar heavy-ball recurrence and the Chebyshev second-kind bound. The embedded verifier checks rational identities and witnesses only; finite computation is not used to justify the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Positive diagonal Hessians in the coordinate basis in which componentwise nonnegativity is tested; zero-velocity initialization; exact classical optimal quadratic heavy-ball parameters; exact arithmetic. Nondiagonal Hessians, projections, adaptive momentum, other initializations, and finite-precision feasibility are not classified.
title: Condition number nine is the positivity frontier for optimally tuned heavy-ball on diagonal quadratics
